title: Blog
subtitle: Stay updated with the latest news, announcements, and insights from Systemvetardagen 2026

paragraphs.content: Systemvetardagen is the annual career fair hosted by DSV where employers and future employees can meet for a day. The work behind SVD continues throughout the year, from the moment that the fair closes its doors until they open again the coming year. The fair is entirely run by students, driven by volunteers who are passionate about improving student life at DSV while gaining valuable experience to add to their CVs. A key part of the organization are the Project coordinators of SVD, and this year they are: Emilia, Matilda and Zihan.
Let’s pick their brains!
Why did they decide to become a coordinator?

For Matilda, getting involved felt like the natural next step. With years of experience in student organizations and a career in medical imaging, SVD was an opportunity to explore new areas and challenge herself. SVD provided the possibility to combine her fields of study by connecting with potential MedTech companies attending the fair.
Emilia, previously a member of SVD’s marketing team of 2024/25, was motivated by her passion for organising events and working with people.

“I've always loved organizing things, working with people, and juggling multiple things at once. I saw becoming a coordinator as a great opportunity to challenge myself and do something meaningful outside of my studies.” - Emilia
Zihan discovered SVD as an international master’s student at DSV, attending SVD 2026. Finding the experience interesting inspired her to get involved in organizing the event herself.
What does a typical week as a coordinator look like? How do they balance their studies and SVD?

The work varies over SVD's phases. Sometimes it's more hands-on with company contact, planning the work, handling the occasional midweek crisis. You follow up on the teams and enable them to manage their work. It’s making sure that the train keeps on running!

SVD puts a heavy emphasis on being able to balance your school and SVD-work life. Having a part-time job too shouldn't be impossible. Open communication is key to making sure the workload remains manageable. Before becoming a part of SVD, it’s important to understand the commitment and planning that goes into it.
It’s not for everyone, but if you feel like it would be beneficial to learn how to prioritise and manage your time, becoming a coordinator can be a valuable experience. However, as Emilia says:
“At the end of the day, I think it's all about mindset. I'm involved in SVD because I want to be, not because I have to”
What has surprised you the most about organizing SVD?
“Everyone is more passionate than I expected.” - Zihan
“How much thought goes into organizing SVD! ..., there's so much happening behind the scenes that you would never think about as a visitor!” - Emilia
“There are so many decisions that need to be decided continuously. Also, that no matter what we do, we handle people and I’m happy to see that AI can’t replace that.” - Matilda
What has been the most rewarding part so far?
“Making friends within our team” - Zihan
“Meeting so many kind, smart and ambitious people.” - Matilda
“Definitely the people!” - Emilia

The vote is unanimous! Although organizing SVD is challenging at times, having great people around you makes balancing everything much easier and a lot more fun! After all, it's not just about organizing a career fair, but also about the connections being made along the way.
What do you hope to achieve with SVD 2027?

We hope that both students and exhibitors gain something valuable. We aim to inspire the visitors that there’s a future in tech waiting for them. Hopefully more than a few LinkedIn connections will be made! We also want everyone involved in SVD to have fun, enjoy and feel proud of what we achieve together.
Matilda sends along wise advice: “Don’t be afraid to apply for something you’re not qualified for on paper!”
Who should apply as coordinator?

People who are ready to make the most of their time at university, challenge themselves and develop their project management and teamwork skills. However, like Emilia says: “You certainly don’t need to have it all figured out. Just be curious, motivated, and willing to learn.”

SVD offers valuable experience to add to your resume, but it is also a highly social experience. You’ll have the opportunity to meet new friends, and if you have friends who are genuinely interested too, why not encourage them to apply? Do it together!
Lastly, Zihan sums up the question perfectly:
“Anyone who wants to experience something exciting!”

After a day filled with inspiration, networking, and exciting meetings with companies, it's time to unwind and celebrate! We invite you to Systemvetardagen's Afterparty & After Work, an evening full of good food, chats and entertainment.
This year's afterparty is a collaboration with

After the fair, Foo Bar opens its doors for a relaxed evening where you can continue networking in a more casual environment. Whether you want to discuss your fair impressions with other students, continue conversations with company representatives, or simply enjoy the atmosphere, this is the perfect opportunity!

keynote.title: Keynote Speaker: Vahid Zohali, Managing Director of IBM Sweden

paragraphs.content: From Curiosity to Impact: A Personal Journey Through Generative AI and Cybersecurity

We are pleased to welcome Vahid Zohali, Managing Director of IBM Sweden, who will share his inspiring and personal journey through the world of IT. From early technical curiosity to leading roles within a global tech organization, Vahid will highlight the lessons, challenges, and key decisions that have shaped his perspective on innovation, leadership, generative AI, and cybersecurity.
About the Lecture

Generative AI is one of the most significant technological shifts of our time and is transforming how we work, lead, and protect digital systems. This lecture explores how generative AI and cybersecurity interact, covering innovation, risks, responsibility, and the future of digital security.
When & Where?
Date: February 18, 2026
Location: Aula NOD

meet.title: Master Systemvetardagen, Sign up for meetings!

paragraphs.content: Systemvetardagen is right around the corner, and while collecting free merch is fun, the real value lies in the connections you make. To help you move beyond small talk and into serious career discussions, we are excited to introduce Systemvetardagen's Meeting Platform.
This all-in-one tool connects students directly with companies for focused, scheduled conversations during the fair.
Sign up now
to secure your dream job.
How It Works
Navigating the platform is simple. Just follow these four steps to get your schedule ready:

items.title: Sign Up:
items.content: Create your profile and select your current educational program.

items.title: Upload Your CV:
items.content: Attach a concise CV so recruiters can quickly assess your fit for their roles.

items.title: Apply:
items.content: Browse companies with open slots and apply for meetings. You will receive confirmations directly in the platform.

items.title: Meet:
items.content: On the day of the fair, meet the company representatives at your scheduled time.

paragraphs.content: Tips for a Successful Interview
Once you have secured your slots, preparation is key. Here is how to make a lasting impression:

items.title: Apply Strategically:
items.content: Quality beats quantity. Don't apply to every single company. Focus on 3–5 companies that truly interest you to ensure more meaningful and relaxed conversations.

items.title: Research & Prepare:
items.content: Look into the company beforehand. Prepare thoughtful questions about their work culture, tech stack, and career opportunities.

items.title: Update Your CV:
items.content: Keep your CV concise (1–2 pages). Highlight relevant projects, skills, and experiences that specifically match the companies you are meeting.

items.title: Arrive Early:
items.content: Show up to your scheduled meeting a few minutes early. Punctuality demonstrates professionalism and gives you a moment to compose yourself.

items.title: Be Authentic:
items.content: Companies value your unique perspective as a student. Be yourself, show genuine interest, and let your personality shine.

items.title: Follow Up:
items.content: Send a brief thank-you email after the fair. It is a great way to reinforce your interest and ensure you stay memorable.

paragraphs.content: Ready to get started?
Log in to the platform
today and start planning your future!

fairie.title: Become a Fair'ie & Help Make Systemvetardagen 2026 Unforgettable!

paragraphs.content: Are you passionate about creating memorable experiences and being part of something bigger? We're looking for enthusiastic Fair'ies to help bring Systemvetardagen 2026 to life!

As a Fair'ie, you'll be at the heart of the action helping with preparations, welcoming companies and guests, guiding visitors, and ensuring everything runs smoothly. You'll enjoy free food and drinks throughout the day, and you'll still have plenty of time to explore the fair and talk to companies yourself.

What do you get in return? If you work you'll earn active DISK status, gain valuable experience for your CV, and network with leading tech companies and ambitious students. Plus, you'll be invited to our exclusive Thank You Party with free food, drinks, music, and celebration!
Ready to join the team?
Sign up here
to express your interest. Closer to the fair, you'll be invited to an information meeting where you'll learn more about the available shifts and what to expect.
Help us make Systemvetardagen 2026 truly unforgettable!

We are incredibly excited to announce that Systemvetardagen is back! From day one of this project, we have dedicated ourselves to planning an unforgettable experience for all students and companies who will participate in this year's jubilee edition, our 30th anniversary!

This milestone is not just a celebration of three decades of connecting students with leading tech companies, but also a testament to the hard work and passion of countless students who have made Systemvetardagen what it is today. Organized entirely by students, for students, through the Student Union DISK, this fair has become the premier event for IT and System Science students in Sweden.
On February 18, 2026, we will welcome leading tech
companies

and visitors to Kista Nod. Whether you're seeking internships, thesis opportunities, or your first career position, Systemvetardagen 2026 will offer unparalleled networking opportunities with industry leaders.

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all participating companies and most importantly, to you, the students who make this event meaningful. We are also looking for dedicated volunteers who want to help create this amazing event! Together, we're not just hosting a job fair; we're building bridges between ambition and opportunity, between education and career, between today's students and tomorrow's leaders.
See you at Systemvetardagen 2026, let's make this jubilee one to remember!
Best regards,
Diana Noran
Tanja Hosseinzadeh
David Singhateh
Project Management Team, Systemvetardagen 2026
